description: This file contains JavaScript functions that manage the display and state of form elements related to database configuration during the installation process of SuiteCRM. The functions toggle visibility and enable/disable certain form inputs based on user interactions.

methods.name: togglePasswordRetypeRequired()
methods.description: Toggles the display of the 'password retype required' input field and adjusts related form fields based on whether the 'create SugarCRM sales user' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: toggleDropTables()
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'drop tables' checkbox based on whether the 'create database' checkbox is checked.

methods.name: toggleUsernameIsPrivileged()
methods.description: Toggles the display of privileged user information based on whether the 'privileged user' checkbox is checked.
